description: Elections Commission - Notify the name B. B. L. R. Gamini Perera as Ward No. 05 Magala of Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of a new member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and processes.
